key_idea: Vertical speed is 1, so time spent in a layer equals its height; horizontal displacement is v times the sum of height*factor, a linear equation in v.
sketch: Effective height = y + sum (u_i - l_i)(f_i - 1); answer = x / effective height. Shields are disjoint so no sorting is needed. O(n), doubles, print with enough digits. x may be negative or zero, which the formula handles.
